title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, with cheaper Astra
summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra, a frontier model for demanding projects, and GPT-6.2 Sol, an efficient model for everyday work, both available in the API as gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol. Astra is priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens—80% of GPT-6 Astra&\#x27;s $10/$50—with cached input at $0.40 per million versus $1 for the older model; Sol stays at $2/$10, the same as GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Sol. Early response is mixed: the source reports Astra trailing Claude Fable 5.2 on some benchmarks and complaints about its communication style, while commenters describe large cost reductions in analytics tasks but poor office-document examples. This is an announcement plus early user testing, not an independent technical evaluation.
